snippet.title: After Light Fades Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
After Light Fades is coming to Steam June 20th!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1717940/After_Light_Fades/

A mystical, magical puzzle game about letting go. After the loss of her beloved partner, Alice is left with seven emotionally resonant artefacts and embarks on a journey to revisit seven of their favourite places and cast each artefact into an abyss, so she can finally be free
